title: DeLonge on 2016 radio: weapon systems built for returning archons

tellings.quote: you look at Tom Dong was like so excitedly talking in 2016 on the radio about this when someone asked about the archons and it was like yeah dude like we've been developing weapon systems because we know they're coming back

plain: In 2016, the musician Tom DeLonge is said to have told a radio interviewer, when asked about archons, ruling spirits from ancient Gnostic belief, that weapon systems were being built "because we know they're coming back." A researcher named Jay Anderson recalls this to Michels, describing DeLonge as speaking very excitedly. If true, it would mean someone was preparing to fight beings expected to return.
